Tribes.leo_description: Leo represents ambition, leadership and the need for recognition. Just like this tribe seeks to leave its mark on the world, you also carry a strong desire to move forward, prove your worth and take control of your own destiny. You dislike feeling powerless or invisible. To you, life is about growth, achievement and becoming someone others respect.
Tribes.lupus_description: Lupus lives through loyalty, emotional connection and protecting the people they love. In the same way, you deeply value genuine bonds and the feeling of belonging somewhere. Even if you seem reserved at first, when you trust or love someone, you do it wholeheartedly. Your greatest fear is not loneliness itself, but losing what feels like home to you.
Tribes.dentes_description: Dentes survives through adaptation, intelligence and constant evolution. You also tend to approach life strategically and thoughtfully, rarely acting without observing first. You prefer understanding the world before trusting it. Deep down, you may have learned that depending too much on others can be dangerous, which is why independence and survival matter so much to you.
Tribes.avis_description: Avis represents freedom, perspective and the search for meaning. Just like they observe the world from above, you often see life from a deeper perspective than most people. Labels and imposed expectations rarely define you; emotional and mental freedom matter far more. For you, life is not only about surviving, but about finding authenticity, peace and purpose.
Tribes.phantus_description: Phantus believes in memory, care and rebuilding what was lost. You are someone who deeply feels the emotional weight of people and experiences. You often protect others even when you are exhausted yourself. There is a part of you that longs for stability and peace in a chaotic world. More than power or recognition, what you truly seek is preserving the things that make life meaningful.

Characters.lia_description: Like Lia, you are disciplined and extremely demanding with yourself. You carry a strong need to fulfill expectations, even when it means holding more emotional weight than people realize. Although you appear strong on the outside, internally you often struggle between what you are supposed to do and what you truly want.
Characters.amelia_description: Like Amelia, you protect your emotions and relationships deeply because you understand how painful betrayal can be. You are loyal, intense and emotionally selective; trust is not something you give easily. Once someone enters your emotional world, you do everything you can to protect them.
Characters.adam_description: Like Adam, you have an intense personality driven by control, discipline and self-improvement. You struggle to tolerate weakness in yourself because part of you constantly feels the need to become stronger. To you, respect is not given freely; it is earned through effort, character and determination.
Characters.annie_description: Like Annie, you carry a free-spirited, emotional and optimistic energy that tries to enjoy life even in the middle of chaos. Even if others see you as relaxed or carefree, emotional freedom matters deeply to you. You need to feel like you can truly be yourself without being trapped by expectations.
Characters.alex_description: Like Alex, you tend to analyze the world before fully trusting it. You are adaptable, strategic and emotionally careful. Deep down, you may have learned to rely on yourself because you know people and situations can change quickly. Your strength comes from your ability to stay calm and think before acting.
Characters.paulo_description: Like Paulo, you are calm, empathetic and protective. You genuinely care about the well-being of the people you love and often try to maintain emotional stability for others even when you are exhausted yourself. To you, survival means nothing without human connection.
